summary: Iteration 28: Validated new PRICING EDITOR (Overview tab) and GALLERY UPLOAD (device upload for images/videos) end-to-end. Backend pytest: 13/13 pass covering PUT /api/admin/settings persistence, GET /api/settings reflection, POST /api/admin/media (image+video, non-media 400 reject, >50MB reject, auth required), full gallery add+delete flow, and regressions (registrations, archived, analytics, reservations toggle). Frontend: pricing editor persists across reload, success toast shows, public Events cards + Barsaat price box (data-testid='barsaat-price-box') reflect new prices in real time. Gallery upload: image (PNG) and video (MP4) both added to grid via device upload; video renders as <video> element with 'Video' badge; paste-URL form still works; delete works; all test items cleaned up. Prices restored to veg=2500 / nonveg=2800.

issues: Many existing gallery items (videos) render as blank black tiles with just a 'VIDEO' badge — no poster/thumbnail preview. Cosmetic only; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is still >1100 lines mixing Overview/Registrations/OffSite/Gallery/Traffic — carried over from prior iterations, still worth splitting into feature files.

update_settings merges body into current — good — but has no numeric coercion/validation for price_veg/price_nonveg (a client could persist negative or non-int values because the field simply passes through since it exists in DEFAULT_SETTINGS). Consider Pydantic model with min>=0 int constraint.

upload_media accepts content_type header from the client without magic-byte verification; a client can label a text file as image/png and it will be stored. Low risk but worth a mimetype sniff (python-magic) for robustness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the tested flows (pricing + gallery upload/paste/delete + public reflection)

seed_data_creation: During gallery test, uploaded 1 png + 1 mp4 + 1 unsplash-URL item — all three were deleted before test end. Prices were temporarily set to 2650/2950 during frontend test then restored to 2500/2800. Backend test also temporarily set 2777/3111 and toggled registrations_open — both restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints validated: PUT /api/admin/settings (accepts price_veg/price_nonveg/registrations_open, merges with DEFAULT_SETTINGS), POST /api/admin/media (multipart file, 50MB limit, image/* or video/* only, returns {url:/api/media/..., kind, content_type}). Uploaded /api/media/{path} serves 200/206. AdminDashboard testids: pricing-editor, price-veg-input, price-nonveg-input, price-save-button, gallery-upload-box, gallery-file-input, gallery-url-input, gallery-add-button, gallery-grid, gallery-item-<id>, gallery-delete-<id>. Public price boxes: barsaat-price-box (BarsaatPage) and section#events (Events.jsx cards). Prices are read live from /api/settings on every page load — no cache issues observed.
rca of the issue: No new issues. Both new features are implemented correctly and pass full end-to-end verification.
